claim_text: In FY25, our total Scope 1 and 2 emissions (from fuel and electricity consumption) continued to trend downwards, achieving a reduction of 17% from the FY20 baseline.
metric_name: Total Scope 1 and 2 emissions; Scope 1 emissions; Scope 2 emissions
context_text: FY25 emissions performance against FY20 baseline: Total Scope 1 and 2 (tCO2-e) 761,424; FY20 (baseline) 919,167; Change (%) ~17. Scope 1 (tCO2-e) 229,680; FY20 (baseline) 231,823; Change (%) ~1. Scope 2 (tCO2-e) 531,744; FY20 (baseline) 687,344; Change (%) ~23.；In FY25, our total Scope 1 and 2 emissions (from fuel and electricity consumption) continued to trend downwards, achieving a reduction of 17% from the FY20 baseline, predominantly attributed to the Cowal and Northparkes PPAs.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: FY25与FY20基线的对比表直接给出总Scope 1+2下降17%，与claim完全一致。
